rules.semantic: With Gameplay Fixes on, the room a raise needs is measured for the body that will actually rise: RAISE SKELETON / RAISE GHOST probe their own family; RESURRECT probes the corpse's old family when the stain is friendly and a ghost when it is a foe's.

arms.observable: the probed family is the given one (a ghost-sized gap suffices for RAISE GHOST)
probed family = blood:s_old_family(); a risen body of that family

tests.note: RAISE UNDEAD probes the skeleton -> (218,212), RAISE GHOST probes the ghost -> (230,200): the given body decides the spot; RESURRECT of a friendly elf rises as an elf at (230,200)
RESURRECT over friendly soldier stains: the near one is refused because a soldier does not fit where an ethereal ghost would, so the old family is what is probed

note: Removed tests/unit/test_pack_lua_paths.cpp PackLuaCleric.resurrecting_a_friendly_corpse_restores_its_family: it runs with gameplay_fixes 0 (TestGameWorld default), so it takes the classic nearby_corpse path and never reaches corpses.lua.

rules.semantic: With Gameplay Fixes on, a raise with no stain within the finder's own cap (squared centre distance < 800 on the caster's floor) refuses NO CORPSE NEARBY and spends nothing.

arms.observable: returns nil, "NO CORPSE NEARBY"; no mana spent, no draw

tests.note: Rig::None, fixes 1: reason NO CORPSE NEARBY, 0 draws, 0 MP, no events
some stain: the scan goes on to raise the far stain

note: Removed PackLuaCleric.corpse_refusals_distinguish_absence_blockage_and_range: it runs with gameplay_fixes 0 and never reaches corpses.lua.

rules.semantic: With Gameplay Fixes on, a raise takes the NEAREST stain inside the cast's Manhattan range that has room for the risen body within 16 px of the corpse corner; a blocked near stain never hides a usable far one; when none qualifies the refusal names a blocked corpse before a far one (CORPSE IS BLOCKED before CORPSE TOO FAR).

arms.when: first in-range stain with a body spot
arms.observable: returns that stain + (sx,sy); the risen body stands at (sx,sy) (within NUDGE=16 px of the corner)

arms.when: stains exist but none in range

tests.note: fixes 1: Rig::Golem -> CORPSE IS BLOCKED, Rig::Far -> CORPSE TOO FAR

note: Removed PackLuaCleric.corpse_refusals_distinguish_absence_blockage_and_range: gameplay_fixes 0, classic path only. Added refusals_spend_nothing_on_both_values, which asserts the BLOCKED and TOO FAR arms with the setting on.

other.note: iterates stains nearest first; the rule is corpses.lua:51
